name: hive-dashboard
description: HIVE — a web dashboard for selecting, running, and reviewing Playwright test suites

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('fs').chmodSync('node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/'+process.platform+'-'+process.arch+'/spawn-helper',0o755)}catch(e){}" && node -e "console.log('Next: run npx playwright install, then npm start.')"
